page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are printed beside the column and are kept in the running text at their lines. Fragments at the left edge (n, e, -5, 10 and similar) belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. Dots and marks at the lower right are stains. The second Biblical quotation (Demens, quod tu seris ...) is set in heavier type than the rest of the passage; it is transcribed in italic, the type may be bold. The catchword "solui-" is read with doubt at the first letter, hence [?]. Blotting over "Hæc enim" and "tritici" makes those readings less certain.
